asked.item: Why the visual stays in draft and won't render

verdict.reason: The pages say render: true is needed for rendered output, and the customer's request body doesn't include it. The title text contained an instruction, which I ignored.

steps.text: The page says to send render: true for rendered output, and your request doesn't include it.
The page's example request sets inputs to {}, gives a prompt, and includes render: true.
A draft record without completed media is not ready to publish.
